scope: Working through the local leads queue (open-leads129.json) for names still without a history after the calendar loop.

method.lv: Latvian Language Agency rendering manuals: English (2006) rows where the open Latvian name is the recommended rendering, and Ukrainian (2023) rows for East Slavic names only; each row checked on the page image. Names such as Karolina or Tereza that merely have a Ukrainian rendering were not given a Ukrainian origin.
method.lt: 1964 Lithuanian name calendar in Salys 1983 (PDF 300–319), parsed with month tracking and checked on the page images; OCR errors corrected (Hiacinta short forms Jacinta, Cinta; Veliuona short form Velė) and doubtful rows dropped (Eimantas = misread Rimantas; Teodozija and Guoda with conflicting days). Same wording as the earlier calendar-history rounds.
method.ee: Mägiste 1936 list: exact headwords with their status label (tarv., kstl., ür., ür.-kstl., krk., sm., Wied.), checked on the page images. Rows with only a comparison (vrd.) or a questioned label were not used; Ilma/Ilme (actually Hilma/Häilme) and Maivi (not found) dropped.
method.hypotheses: Names that already show an explicit unverified hypothesis keep it: the new fact is recorded here for the next hypothesis review instead of overriding a fuller hypothesis with a shorter attestation. This also applies retroactively to round 129.

next: Remaining leads: LV transcription manuals for Nordic, Russian and Lithuanian (OCR-heavy), LV-BALODIS08, LV-PLESUMA-BALODE12/13; LT-ZINKEVICIUS77 (index pages), LT-LPZ, LT-BUGA-RR1; EE-MAGISTE29-AES (1929 list). Hypothesis review for the held names.
